User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Admin panel — no benefit to indexing, and nothing here renders the site.
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /contact.php

# NOTE — /data/ and /uploads/ are deliberately NOT disallowed.
#
# This site is rendered entirely in the browser: every page is built from
# /data/products-all.json, /data/site-info.json and /data/content.json
# (src/App.jsx). A crawler's renderer obeys robots.txt for those fetches, so
# "Disallow: /data/" did not hide the files — it made all 42 product pages plus
# /products, /dashboard and /datasheets render the catalog-error state for
# Googlebot, while sitemap.php (a server-side read, unaffected) went on
# advertising those 52 URLs. Under the robots protocol the longest match wins,
# so the rule also beat "Allow: /".
#
# The files stay out of search results by header instead — data/.htaccess sends
# X-Robots-Tag: noindex — which keeps the raw JSON unindexed AND lets the
# renderer fetch it. /uploads/ holds product photos, which should reach Google
# Images. (audit-runs/audit5.md A-5.2)

Sitemap: https://www.insulationproducts.com/sitemap.xml
